name: ui-click
prompt: Short soft UI button tap, a gentle plastic click with a warm rounded attack, dry and close, no reverb tail.

name: ui-focus
prompt: Very quiet hover tick, a faint fingernail tap on a wooden surface, extremely short and subtle.

name: orb-pick
prompt: A small glass marble being lifted out of a glass tube, delicate clink with a slight upward suction slide, bright and clean.

name: orb-drop
prompt: A glass marble dropping into a tall glass tube and landing with a resonant clink, brief glassy ring decaying quickly.

name: orb-stack
prompt: A glass marble clacking firmly onto another matching glass marble, crisp ceramic-on-glass knock with a satisfying snap.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Soft muted error thunk, a low dull knock on padded wood with a short downward pitch bend, gentle and non-harsh.

name: tube-complete
prompt: Small ascending chime arpeggio of three glass bell notes, sparkling and delicate, celebrating a finished tube.

name: round-win
prompt: Bright celebratory flourish of tuned glass chimes and a gentle shimmer of small bells, rising major-key cascade with a soft glitter tail.

name: round-lose
prompt: Three soft descending wooden mallet tones, mellow marimba-like fall, subdued and sympathetic rather than punishing.

name: undo-swoosh
prompt: Quick airy reverse whoosh, a short cloth swipe sucked backward, light and fast with a soft end.

name: hint-chime
prompt: Gentle high bell ping, a single pure metal chime tone with a soft mallet strike and a short shimmering decay.

name: timer-tick
prompt: Single precise clock tick, a small mechanical snap like a watch escapement, very short and dry.
